name: Citywide greenhouse gas emissions
definition: Total citywide greenhouse gas emissions from the City's annual inventory, in million metric tons of CO2-equivalent (100-year global warming potential), by calendar year.

source.name: NYC Mayor's Office of Climate and Environmental Justice, Inventory of New York City Greenhouse Gas Emissions, via NYC Open Data (wq7q-htne)

method: The dataset's 'Total' row, column tCO2e for each calendar year (100-year global warming potential; the 2005-2009 columns are labeled tco2e_100_yr_gwp and later ones tco2e), divided by one million. The script checks that the sector rows add up to the Total row each year. The sector breakdown sums the rows of each sector for 2024.
caveats: The open dataset carries the whole 2005-2024 series as recalculated in the current inventory, so earlier years can differ from the figures first published in older inventory reports; the dataset itself does not describe the restatements (dataset description: 'The Inventory of New York City Greenhouse Gas Emissions is an annual report that measures where emissions come from and tracks the City’s progress in reducing t').

Covers emissions inside the city plus electricity generated elsewhere for city use, under the Global Protocol for Community-Scale inventories; a 20-year-GWP version of each value is also in the dataset.
The dataset includes 'CLCPA Addition' rows (state climate-law accounting additions); they are zero in every year, so they do not affect the totals.
